Class GameClock

java.lang.Object
simscli.GameClock
public final class GameClock extends Object
Manages in-game time with real-time synchronization. Converts real-time (in seconds) to game-time (in minutes) at a fixed rate: 1440 game minutes per 10 real-time seconds (2.4 game minutes per real second). Each day has 1440 minutes (00:00 to 23:59). Key Features: - Tracks current day number and minute-of-day independently - Handles fractional minute remainders for smooth time progression - Accumulates minutes to detect hourly milestones - Supports time advancement via real-time deltas or direct minute spending Time flows from minuteOfDay 0 (midnight) to 1439 (23:59), then wraps to next day.

  • Method Details

    • advanceByRealTime

      public void advanceByRealTime(double deltaSeconds)
      Advances game time based on elapsed real-world seconds. Accumulates fractional minutes across multiple calls and converts whole minutes into in-game time. Detects hourly milestones and triggers onHourPassed callback.
      Parameters:
      deltaSeconds - the number of real-world seconds elapsed since last call (non-positive values are ignored)

    • getHoursPassedFromAccumulator

      public int getHoursPassedFromAccumulator()
      Retrieves and clears accumulated hours from the minute accumulator. Resets the accumulator after extracting the hour count, allowing external systems to know when a full hour has elapsed.
      Returns:
      the number of complete hours accumulated

    • spendMinutes

      public void spendMinutes(int minutes)
      Directly spends (advances) game time by a specified number of minutes. Used when actions consume time. Properly handles day boundary transitions, advancing day number and wrapping minute-of-day as needed.
      Parameters:
      minutes - the number of game minutes to advance (non-positive values ignored)

    • getMinutesLeftToday

      public int getMinutesLeftToday()
      Calculates remaining minutes until end of current day (midnight). At 00:00 (midnight) returns 1440; at 23:59 returns 1. Useful for scheduling events that must occur before day end.
      Returns:
      minutes remaining in current day

    • getFormattedTime

      public String getFormattedTime()
      Returns a formatted time string in HH:MM format.
      Returns:

    • resetToNextDayMorning

      public void resetToNextDayMorning()
      Resets the game clock to the next day at 8:00 AM. Used when a Sim faints and must spend the remainder of the day unconscious. Clears remaining game time and starts fresh at 08:00 (480 minutes into day).

    • resetNewGame

      public void resetNewGame()
      Resets the game clock to the initial state for a new game. Sets clock to Day 1, 08:00 AM (480 minutes). Clears all accumulated time remnants.
